definitions.explanation: A liquid fossil fuel used for energy and making products.

examples.japanese: {石油|せきゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
{石油|せきゆ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}している→輸入する：01742_yunyuu⟧。
{石油|せきゆ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}られた→限る：02033_kagiru⟧⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{石油|せきゆ} means petroleum or crude oil, a major energy source.

WRITING:
⟦{石|せき}→石：02177_ishi⟧ (stone) + ⟦{油|ゆ}→油：01693_abura⟧ (oil) - "stone oil" (oil from the ground).

COMPOUNDS:
- {石油|せきゆ}⟦{会社|がいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧: oil company
- {石油|せきゆ}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: oil prices
- {石油|せきゆ}⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: petroleum products
- {石油|せきゆ}⟦{産出|さんしゅつ}→産出：19750_sanshutsu⟧⟦{国|こく}→国：02204_kuni⟧: oil-producing country

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{灯油|とうゆ}→灯油：04071_touyu⟧: kerosene (for heating)
- ⟦ガソリン→ガソリン：01346_gasorin⟧: gasoline
- ⟦{原油|げんゆ}→原油：21637_genyu⟧: crude oil

USAGE:
Japan imports nearly all its {石油|せきゆ}, primarily from the Middle East. {石油|せきゆ}⟦ショック→ショック：03847_shokku⟧ (oil shock) refers to the 1970s oil crises.
